progress.crouzeix-palencia: Assume (status `assumed` once a consumer is formalised): the statement is short, polynomial-only (no holomorphic functional calculus needed) and certain; the proof (Cauchy-transform / double-layer potential on the boundary of a convex set) is research-level to formalise. Stating it for polynomials sidesteps Mathlib's lack of a functional calculus for non-normal matrices. Consumers: arnoldi-fa-error, the GMRES field-of-values bound above, non-normal Krylov f(A)b and trace-of-f(A) estimators for nonsymmetric A.
progress.abs-best-approx-asymptotics: Consumers: sign-approx-lower-bound / sign-polynomial-approx (the polynomial rate for $|x|$ is $\Theta(1/n)$, so gap-free sign approximation cannot beat $1/n$; a non-asymptotic $E_{n,0}(|x|)\ge c/n$ is the useful part and follows from Bernstein-type arguments). Assume the asymptotics; prove only a non-asymptotic lower bound if a consumer needs it.
progress.exp-rational-halfline: Consumers: rational Krylov / shift-invert approximation of $e^{-tA}b$ for PSD $A$ (the Sachdeva–Vishnoi rational section, Laplacian solvers), where a non-asymptotic $3^{-n}$-type upper bound would be the usable form. Assume; low priority.

The exact variance, unnormalized vectorized covariance and literal bilinear weak parameters retain the source normalization. The universal constant is explicitly 10^20. Both spectral inclusions, the Hausdorff tail and mean, minimum-eigenvalue, maximum-eigenvalue and operator-norm tails and actual expectation differences are proved for all t>=0, including zero variance and arbitrary deterministic mean. Genuine finite-N interpolation, native free endpoint limits, actual moment comparison, finite grids, Gaussian localization/concentration, faithful model transport and law transport are derived; no spectral, probability, comparison or model certificate is a premise.
progress.gaussian-quadratic-free-spectrum: The full source Theorem 2.5 is proved for actual non-Hermitian Gaussian coefficient series, arbitrary Hermitian shifts and arbitrary faithful positive free semicircular models on any probability space carrying the genuine joint Gaussian law. The explicit universal constant is 10^44. The actual source variance, unnormalized vectorized covariance and literal bilinear weak variance retain their original normalization. Genuine three-block affine identities, actual positive square roots, continuous native free spectra, positive-gap matching and quantitative squaring derive the probability statement. Zero weak variance gives pointwise deterministic equality. No dilation, spectral comparison, probability or model certificate is a premise.
progress.block-wishart-variational-edges: The full source edge card is proved for every compact Hermitian probability sample law and alpha>0, including singular and indefinite samples. The native analytic K branch and actual compact Stieltjes probability law are constructed. The exact lower-support-edge supremum, equivalent strict-positivity finite derivative witnesses, and reflected upper-support-edge formula are proved. No branch, law, gap, edge equality, reflection law or optimizer attainment is a premise. Stable optimizer attainment is not asserted; it generally fails even for the zero sample law.
progress.block-wishart-log-potential: The full variational logarithmic-potential theorem is proved for every compact Hermitian probability sample law and alpha>0, including singular and indefinite samples. The native analytic K branch and compact characterized probability trace law are constructed. At every real point below the actual lower support edge, a genuine stable matrix solves K(S)=uI, its source potential divided by the dimension equals the actual logarithmic potential, and it attains the global minimum over the original strict Frobenius-stable domain. Actual determinant positivity, convexity of the native stable image, local analytic inversion, the genuine Frechet gradient, real trace-law boundary continuity, and normalization at negative infinity are all derived from the original equation and sample law. progress.independent-sum-spectrum-universality: The full retained Hausdorff spectral tail is proved for actual independent bounded centered Hermitian random matrices and every mean- and full-entry-covariance-matching jointly Gaussian Hermitian matrix, with arbitrary coupling and deterministic mean.
